standard_prerequisites.name: Dg E-module and dg bimodule
standard_prerequisites.statement: A module over the dg algebra E together with a differential, and a complex carrying compatible left E-module and right O(U)-module structures.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof observes that each K(U) is a dg (E, O(U))-bimodule (source lines 6132-6135).

standard_prerequisites.name: Tensor functor with a dg bimodule
standard_prerequisites.statement: Tensoring with a dg bimodule is a functor of dg categories, sending the algebra to the bimodule and preserving direct sums (the author's lemma lemma-tensor, retained as context).
standard_prerequisites.use: It supplies the pointwise functors and the preservation of direct sums (source lines 6136-6138, 6149-6151).

standard_prerequisites.name: Complexes of O-modules on a site
standard_prerequisites.statement: The dg category of complexes of O-modules on the site under consideration, with the pointwise evaluation functors.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the target category of the constructed functor (source lines 6122-6126, 6145-6148).

core_obligations: Identify the pointwise bimodule: for each object U of the site, note that K(U) is a left dg E-module and a right O(U)-module with commuting actions (source lines 6132-6135).

Build the pointwise functors and assemble them: apply the retained tensor-functor lemma to get, for each U, a functor of dg categories from dg E-modules to complexes of O(U)-modules, and check that these are compatible with the restriction maps in U so that they assemble into a functor into complexes of O-modules (source lines 6136-6152).
Check the two stated properties: show that the assembled functor sends E to K and commutes with direct sums, both read off from the pointwise statement (source lines 6127-6128, 6149-6152).

proof_roadmap.step: Observe that each K(U) is a dg (E, O(U))-bimodule.
Apply the tensor-functor lemma pointwise and assemble the pointwise functors into a functor to complexes of O-modules.
Read off that the functor sends E to K and preserves direct sums.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-tensor-with-complex at source lines 6118-6129: in the situation considered above there is a functor of differential graded categories from dg E-modules to the dg category of complexes of O-modules, tensoring with the complex K, which sends E to K and commutes with direct sums. The proof at source lines 6131-6153 is a reduction to the pointwise statement plus the two structure checks. It observes that for every object U of the site the complex K(U) is simultaneously a left dg E-module and a right O(U)-module with commuting actions, that is, a dg bimodule, so that the author's tensor functor with this bimodule gives a functor of dg categories at each U; it then has to see that these pointwise functors assemble into a functor landing in the dg category of complexes of O-modules, which uses the functoriality of the construction in U, and finally that the assembled functor sends E to K and preserves direct sums, which is read off from the pointwise statement. The statement records none of these three observations. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
